_comment: Title templates tuned on channel data (proven hooks), WITHOUT serial numbering. YouTube's 2026 inauthentic-content enforcement explicitly lists formulaic numbered titles ('Lofi Mix #47') as a mass-production detection signature — the old '#292' pattern painted a target on the channel. Hooks kept exactly as proven (You NEED This 1822, Late Night Tribal Drive 660, Hits DIFFERENT 378...). Placeholders: TRACKNAME, {genre}, {genre_hashtag}. One template per upload, not repeating within the last TITLE_HISTORY_WINDOW picks.
templates: TRACKNAME 🔥 If You Love {genre}, You NEED This Mix | {genre_hashtag}
TRACKNAME 🔥 Late Night Tribal Drive • {genre} Mix | {genre_hashtag}
TRACKNAME 🔥 This Track Made Me Fall In Love With {genre} | {genre_hashtag}
